{{Current events|year=2026|month=04|day=25|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign]]
*****[[Federal Ministry of Defence (Germany)|German defense minister]] [[Boris Pistorius]] says that [[Germany]] will deploy [[German Navy|naval]] units, including a [[minesweeper]] and a command and supply ship for a potential mission in the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20260425-germany-to-deploy-naval-units-to-the-mediterranean-ahead-of-potential-strait-of-hormuz-mission/ (Middle East Monitor)]
****The ''[[Nord (yacht)|Nord]]'', a [[superyacht]] linked to sanctioned [[Russia]]n oligarch [[Alexei Mordashov]], crosses the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.gazetaexpress.com/en/A-superyacht-passes-the-Strait-of-Hormuz--reportedly-belonging-to-a-Russian-oligarch./ (''Gazeta Express'')] [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/h1rxvd9azg (''Ynetnews'')]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] cancels sending special envoys [[Steve Witkoff]] and [[Jared Kushner]] to [[Islamabad]], [[Pakistan]], for negotiations. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/25/trump-cancels-envoys-trip-to-pakistan-after-irans-araghchi-leaves-country (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
***[[Gaza war]]
****[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
*****The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] says that an airstrike on the [[Gaza Strip]] has killed several [[Hamas]] militants who planned attacks on Israeli troops, including  Hazem Rami Ali Aidi, a Hamas commander who took part in the [[October 7, 2023 attacks]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-recent-gaza-strike-killed-several-hamas-operatives-including-terrorist-who-invaded-on-oct-7/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****An [[Israel]]i attack kills four people in [[Yohmor, Nabatieh|Yohmor]], [[Nabatieh District]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://aje.news/vy4nmo?update=4521272 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mali War]]
**[[2026 Mali attacks]]
***Multiple armed groups launch several coordinated attacks across [[Mali]], including in the capital [[Bamako]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/25/mali-army-says-armed-groups-launch-nationwide-attacks-gunfire-near-airport (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Tuareg people|Tuareg]] rebels say they have seized control of [[Kidal]] in northern Mali after overrunning [[Malian Armed Forces|government forces]]. [https://www.theafricareport.com/416315/mali-heavy-fighting-erupts-in-bamako-as-rebels-seize-northern-stronghold-kidal/ (The Africa Report)]
***Residents and a reporter from the [[Associated Press]] says that gunfire has been heard near the [[Modibo Keita International Airport]]. [https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/international/2026/04/25/gunfire-heard-near-malis-main-international-airport-in-capital-ap-reporter-and-residents-say.amp.html (AFP via ''The Week'')]
***Military bases are targeted, including the main military base in [[Kati, Mali|Kati]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/loud-blasts-gunfire-heard-near-malis-main-military-camp-reuters-witness-says-2026-04-25/ (Reuters)]
***Defence minister [[Sadio Camara]] is killed by a [[Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin|JNIM]] [[Suicide attack|suicide]] [[car bomb]] at his home in Kati. Camara's wife and two of his grandchildren are also killed. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260426-new-fighting-in-mali-s-kidal-between-army-and-rebels-1 (AFP via France 24)]
***[[SITE Intelligence Group]] says that the [[Al-Qaeda]]-linked JNIM and [[Tuareg people|Tuareg]]-dominated ⁠rebel group [[Azawad Liberation Front|FLA]] has claimed full responsibility for the attacks. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/al-qaeda-linked-jnim-says-it-carried-out-mali-attacks-with-tuaregled-fla-site-2026-04-25/ (Reuters)]
***The [[Mali Army]] representative Suleiman Dembele confirms that 80 militants have been eliminated across the country in wake of the attacks. [https://caliber.az/en/post/malian-army-confirms-80-militants-neutralised-in-nationwide-operations (Caliber.Az)]
***A [[Malian Air Force]] [[Mil Mi-24]] helicopter is shot down by rebel forces near [[Gao]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clyx7nnrkqdo (BBC News)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Dnipro strikes (2022–present)|Dnipro strikes]]
***An overnight [[Unmanned Systems Forces (Russia)|Russian drone]] and [[ballistic missile]] attack on [[Dnipro]], [[Ukraine]], kills ten people and injures 49 others. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4116645-russian-attacks-on-dnipro-kill-eight-wound-49.html (Ukrinform)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/major-russian-attack-ukraine-kills-four-wounds-dozens-2026-04-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War]]
**[[Piracy off the coast of Somalia]]
***[[Somalia|Somali]] [[Somali pirates|pirates]] attack and seize an [[oil tanker]] off [[Mogadishu]], taking 11 [[Pakistanis|Pakistani]] crew members [[hostage]]. [https://www.brecorder.com/news/40418116 (''Business Recorder'')] [https://english.aaj.tv/news/330457405 (AAJ)] [https://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/24-Apr-2026/11-pakistani-crew-held-hostages-as-pirates-seize-oil-tanker-near-somalia (''Daily Pakistan'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***At least seven people are killed in [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] targeting [[El-Obeid]], [[North Kordofan]], [[Sudan]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article/313138 (''Sudan Tribune'')] [https://easternherald.com/2026/04/26/rsf-suicide-drone-attack-kills-7-civilians-in-el-obeid-medics-say/ (''Eastern Herald'')]
*[[War on drugs#War on cartels (2025–present)|War on drugs]]
**[[Operation Southern Spear]]
***The [[United States Armed Forces|US military]] announces that it has [[United States strikes on alleged drug traffickers during Operation Southern Spear|struck]] an alleged drug boat in the [[Pacific Ocean|eastern Pacific]], killing two people. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-drug-cartels-pacific-ocean-42e0097eea2b04bbec4f84afed237d71 (AP)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[2026 Cauca bombing]]
***Fourteen people are killed and 38 others are injured in a [[bomb]]ing on a bus on the [[Pan-American Highway]] in [[Cauca Department]], [[Colombia]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/04/25/americas/colombia-highway-bombing-dead-latam-intl (CNN)]
*At least 42 people are killed in intercommunal clashes in [[Guéréda]], [[Wadi Fira (region)|Wadi Fira]], [[Chad]], after a dispute over a [[well]], prompting [[Government of Chad|the government]] to deploy officials and [[Chadian National Army|security forces]] to the area. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2641395/world (AFP via ''Arab News'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Imam Khomeini International Airport]] in [[Tehran]], Iran, resumes international flights for the first time since the war began two months ago. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/iran-resumes-commercial-flights-tehrans-international-airport (''Middle East Eye'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2026]]
** [[2026 Ōtsuchi wildfire]]
*** More than 1,000 [[firefighter]]s are deployed and 3,000 people are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] from their homes in [[Ōtsuchi, Iwate]], [[Japan]], as two [[wildfire]]s continue to grow in the region. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/firefighters-japan-struggle-contain-iwate-blazes-with-over-3000-evacuated-2026-04-25/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia]] states that it will not assist in the repatriation of [[Australians|its nationals]] associated with suspected [[Islamic State]] members from camps in [[Syria]], while the [[Australian intelligence community|intelligence community]] monitors potential returns and warns that any individuals who committed crimes will face prosecution. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2641208/middle-east (AFP via ''Arab News'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Security incidents involving Donald Trump]]
**[[2026 White House Correspondents' Dinner shooting]]
***Gunshots are fired during the [[White_House_Correspondents%27_Association#White_House_Correspondents'_dinner|White House Correspondents' Dinner]] at the [[Washington Hilton]] hotel. Attendees such as [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]], [[First Lady of the United States|first lady]] [[Melania Trump]], and [[Vice President of the United States|vice president]] [[JD Vance]] are evacuated unharmed. The suspect, a 31-year-old man, is detained and taken into custody.  [https://www.cnn.com/2026/04/25/politics/trump-rushed-white-house-correspondents-dinner (CNN)] [https://www.the-independent.com/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-white-house-correspondents-dinner-live-updates-b2964913.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-removed-white-house-correspondents-dinner-attendees-take-cover-2026-04-26/ (Reuters)] [https://wtop.com/dc/2026/04/suspect-in-custody-after-shooting-at-white-house-correspondents-dinner/ (WTOP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Aftermath of the [[2026 Hungarian parliamentary election]] and [[Magyar government]] formation
**Outgoing [[Prime Minister of Hungary|Hungarian prime minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]] announces that he will resign from his seat in [[National Assembly (Hungary)|parliament]] after his defeat in the recent election that ended his [[Hungary under Viktor Orbán|16-year tenure]] in [[Hungary]]. However, he also stated that he plans to remain as leader of [[Fidesz]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/orban-relinquishes-seat-in-hungarys-parliament/ (''Politico Europe'')] [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2026/04/25/hungary-viktor-orban-leave-parliament/3611777161571/ (UPI)]
*[[Corruption in Malaysia]]
**The [[Anwar Ibrahim cabinet]] appoints [[Abdul Halim Aman]] as head of the [[Malaysia]]n [[Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission|Anti-Corruption Commission]], replacing [[Azam Baki]], whose tenure drew scrutiny over alleged misconduct. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2641214/world (AFP via ''Arab News'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysia-names-former-judge-head-anti-corruption-agency-after-scandals-2026-04-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Palestinian local elections]]
**The election of 403 local authorities takes place in Palestine.[https://www.arabnews.com/node/2630619/middle-east (AFP via ''Arab News'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Censorship of Wikipedia]], [[internet censorship in Indonesia]]
**The [[Wikimedia Foundation]] reaches an agreement with the [[Indonesia]]n [[Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs|communications ministry]] to comply with the country's electronic system registration rules after discussions addressed concerns over content removal and data disclosure requirements, averting a potential block of [[Wikipedia]] in the country. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/under-blackout-threat-wikimedia-reaches-compromise-with-indonesia (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
